name: Air transport, passengers carried
citation: World Bank Group. Air transport, passengers carried [Data set]. International Civil Aviation Organization, Civil Aviation Statistics of the World and ICAO staff estimates. https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/IS.AIR.PSGR
description: Annual observations tracking the total number of domestic and international aircraft passengers of air carriers registered in the country. For this univariate dataset, we are extracting and using only the historical data specific to the United States.
preprocessing: Load API_IS.AIR.PSGR_DS2_en_csv_v2_115540.csv with skiprows=4 (World Bank wide format).
Filter to Country Name == United States; melt year columns (1960–2023) to long format.
Construct timestamps as {year}-12-31 UTC; value column passengers; drop rows with NaN passengers.
Removed: all other countries and wide year columns after melt.
Transform: variable_name=Air transport, passengers carried - United States, variable_unit=Count.

Output CSV schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps (JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings), values (JSON array; NaN serialized as null via allow_nan=True). Timestamps are shared across variates in multivariate tasks (one row per variate).
